source.name: Componentry
source.method: 공식 저장소 고정 commit의 registry·코드 수집
source.note: 53개 UI와 3개 블록의 MIT 원본을 보존하고 예시 입력으로 로컬 렌더링했습니다. GSAP 의존 항목과 제품 이식은 별도 검토합니다.

additions.title: Animated Gradient
additions.description: A beautiful, animated, and customizable WebGL gradient with noise capabilities.

additions.title: ASCII Effect
additions.description: Render images as responsive ASCII artwork with image, flow, and glitch variations.

additions.title: Aurora Flow
additions.description: Procedural atmospheric hero background with layered flowing color, diffused aurora light, and subtle interaction.

additions.title: Case Study Flip Stack
additions.description: Editorial case study cards that fold upward on scroll to reveal the next story.

additions.title: Circuit Board
additions.description: Animated circuit board visualization with nodes and connections.

additions.title: Closing Plasma
additions.description: Plasma field tailored for footer and CTA sections with premium atmospheric motion.

additions.title: Collection Surfer
additions.description: Smooth surfing interaction for browsing collections.

additions.title: Particle Typography
additions.description: Renders dynamic typography constructed entirely from particles that elegantly disperse and reassemble upon cursor interaction using spring physics.

additions.title: Dither Gradient
additions.description: Gradient background with dithering noise.

additions.title: Dither Prism Hero
additions.description: Stunning WebGL hero with advanced dithering, prismatic refraction, holographic iridescence, and center-focused energy.

additions.title: Dithered Logo
additions.description: An interactive particle logo that turns image assets into a dithered canvas field with cursor ripples.

additions.title: Eye Tracking
additions.description: Hyper-realistic eyes that follow your cursor with smooth spring physics, reactive pupils, blinking, and multiple stunning variants.

additions.title: Fisheye Infinite Grid
additions.description: A dense draggable image wall warped as one continuous fisheye surface with weighted momentum.

additions.title: Flight Status Card
additions.description: A detailed card showing flight information with animations.

additions.title: Flipping Word Swap
additions.description: A clean character-by-character flip between two words on interaction.

additions.title: Github Calendar
additions.description: GitHub-style contribution calendar heatmap.

additions.title: Hero Geometric
additions.description: Geometric shapes and patterns for hero sections.

additions.title: Hover Transition
additions.description: Eight polished hover transitions with per-card animation, direction, color, and content controls.

additions.title: Image Ripple Effect
additions.description: WebGL-powered cursor ripples that displace layered image cards in real time.

additions.title: Image Trail
additions.description: Leaves a trail of images behind the cursor with a premium delay fade.

additions.title: Infinite Image Field
additions.description: An endless, cursor-driven photo canvas that tiles images infinitely and pans fluidly toward wherever you move your cursor.

additions.title: Kinetic Text Reveal
additions.description: Directional text reveal with soft blur and configurable word, character, or line stagger timing.

additions.title: Layered Stack
additions.description: A stack of layered cards that interact with mouse hover.

additions.title: Letter Cascade
additions.description: Kinetic text animation where letters scatter outward with spring physics and blur, then elegantly reassemble.

additions.title: Liquid Chrome
additions.description: Premium fluid liquid metal shader background effect.

additions.title: Mac Keyboard
additions.description: A realistic Mac keyboard component with interactive keys and detailed styling.

additions.title: Magnet Lines
additions.description: Lines that react to cursor movement like a magnetic field.

additions.title: Magnetic Dock
additions.description: MacOS style dock that scales items based on mouse proximity.

additions.title: Matrix Rain
additions.description: Classic Matrix digital rain effect.

additions.title: Music Player
additions.description: A fun interactive vinyl record music player with swinging tonearm.

additions.title: Newsletter Bookshelf
additions.description: A tactile 3D newsletter archive with hover lift, camera browsing, centered covers, and automatic drag-adjustable orbiting.

additions.title: Orbit Card Stack
additions.description: Premium hover card deck that fans outward and lifts the active card without changing its color or angle.

additions.title: Pixel Canvas
additions.description: Canvas where pixels react to interaction.

additions.title: Pixel Image Trail
additions.description: An image reveal made from cursor-painted squares that expire into a bounded pixel trail.

additions.title: Prism Gradient
additions.description: A theme-aware WebGL prism field with liquid checkered motion, electric-blue refraction, and tactile grain.

additions.title: Ripple Transition
additions.description: WebGL image transitions with noisy refractive waves, chromatic edges, glow, and click-triggered ripple origins.

additions.title: Velocity Scroll
additions.description: Text that moves horizontally based on scroll speed.

additions.title: Scroll Choreography
additions.description: A smooth, scroll-driven image choreography component using Framer Motion.

additions.title: Scroll Split Card
additions.description: A scroll-driven interactive card that splits into three panels and flips.

additions.title: Scroll Tilted Grid
additions.description: A cinematic image grid that tilts and resolves into focus as each frame crosses the viewport.

additions.title: Signature
additions.description: An animated SVG signature effect that draws out text as if hand-written.

additions.title: Silk Aurora
additions.description: Premium WebGL hero background with satin-dark aurora ribbons, pearlescent highlights, fine grain, and cursor depth.

additions.title: Spiral 3D Slider
additions.description: A compact, autoplaying image gallery that responds to scroll along a smooth 3D spiral.

additions.title: Split Flap Display
additions.description: A premium split-flap display component inspired by vintage departure boards.

additions.title: Sticky Scroll Cards
additions.description: A scroll-driven card stack where images pin and scale as you scroll, creating a layered depth effect.

additions.title: Text Morph
additions.description: Centered fluid text transitions that inherit the surrounding typography and theme.

additions.title: Text Repel
additions.description: Physics-based text where each letter reacts to cursor proximity with spring dynamics, creating an interactive magnetic force-field effect.

additions.title: WebGL Liquid
additions.description: Cinematic liquid shader hero with premium gradients, configurable reveal timing, and advanced flow controls.

additions.title: Wheel Carousel
additions.description: A cinematic rotating-wheel picker with inertial drag, curved fading labels, and crossfading project imagery.

additions.title: Annotated Text
additions.description: Hand-drawn marks — circles, highlights, underlines, cross-outs — sketched around inline text.

additions.title: Grain Gradient
additions.description: A breathing color field with flowing shadows, customizable film grain, and soft atmospheric light.

additions.title: Spectral Ribbon
additions.description: A soft spectral light ribbon on pure black — slow liquid motion and rainbow fringe.

additions.title: Liquid Glass Carousel
additions.description: An infinite image carousel seen through a WebGL liquid-glass lens — chromatic rim, snap scroll, and a focus expand.

additions.title: Gradient Hero 01
additions.description: A simple centered hero with a warm cinematic gradient, compact badge, short copy, and two actions.

additions.title: Pricing 01
additions.description: Three tactile pricing cards with revealed hover notes, clear feature lists, and a highlighted popular plan.

additions.title: Pricing 02
additions.description: A compact pricing table with separated plan summaries, detailed feature lists, and an animated billing-cycle switch.
